articles.title: While Patrick Mahomes rules the NFL, Brittany Mahomes Is building her own women’s soccer legacy with the Kansas City current’s $140 million stadium
articles.summary: Patrick Mahomes has spent years making a name for himself in the NFL, winning Super Bowls and becoming one of the most recognised quarterbacks in American
articles.body: Patrick Mahomes has spent years making a name for himself in the NFL, winning Super Bowls and becoming one of the most recognised quarterbacks in American football. But while his career with the Kansas City Chiefs often puts the family in the headlines, Brittany Mahomes has been working on something of her own. She is a co-owner of the Kansas City Current, a professional women’s soccer team that is helping bring more attention to women’s sports. Her journey from playing soccer to owning a club shows that her story is about much more than being married to an NFL star. She has her own sporting background, business interests and a role in shaping the future of women’s soccer.How did Brittany Mahomes go from playing soccer to owning a professional team?Long before Brittany became known to NFL fans, soccer was already a big part of her life. She played the sport at the University of Texas at Tyler, where she earned a degree in kinesiology. She later played professional soccer in Iceland for a year before turning her attention to fitness and business.Her experience as a player gave her a closer look at the demands of competitive sport and the work athletes put in behind the scenes. After leaving professional soccer, she launched an online fitness training business in 2019, giving her another way to stay connected to sports and help people work towards their fitness goals.Her move into team ownership came in December 2020, when Brittany joined Angie and Chris Long in bringing a new National Women’s Soccer League team to Kansas City. The club was first known as Kansas City NWSL before taking the name Kansas City Current in 2021.This was an important step in her career because she was no longer involved in sports only as a player. She now had a role in building a club, helping it grow and giving women’s soccer a stronger place in the city. Patrick Mahomes joined the ownership group in 2023, but Brittany had been part of the project from its early days.What has Brittany Mahomes done for the Kansas City current?Owning a professional sports team involves much more than attending matches and supporting players from the stands. It means helping build a club that can attract fans, find business partners, provide the right facilities and compete at a high level.Brittany is part of the ownership group behind the Kansas City Current, which has invested in its players, training facilities and wider presence in the community. The aim has been to build a club where women’s soccer receives serious attention and the athletes have the resources they need to perform.One of the clearest signs of that ambition came in 2021, when the owners announced plans for a new stadium. The project gave the Current a chance to create a permanent home designed specifically for women’s professional soccer rather than having to share a venue built for another team.The club’s progress has also been visible on the pitch. In 2024, the Current scored 57 regular-season goals and recorded 16 wins. A year later, they won the 2025 NWSL Shield after finishing the regular season with the league’s best record. The award was the first in the club’s history.These results cannot be credited to one owner alone. Players, coaches, staff and the entire ownership group have played their parts. Still, the team’s growth shows why Brittany’s involvement is worth covering as a sports story in its own right.Why Is CPKC Stadium such an important part of Brittany Mahomes’ work?When CPKC Stadium opened in March 2024, it gave the Kansas City Current something few professional women’s teams had ever had: a stadium built specifically for a women’s professional sports team.Located along Kansas City’s riverfront, the venue has a capacity of around 11,500 and was privately funded by the club’s ownership group. It hosted its first match on March 16, 2024, when the Current beat the Portland Thorns 5-4 in front of a sold-out crowd.The stadium matters because facilities affect how athletes train, compete and prepare for games. A dedicated venue also gives a team greater control over its matchday experience, ticket sales, events and relationships with fans.For Brittany, the project connects her background as a soccer player with her work as an owner. She knows the sport from the playing side, but she is now also part of a group investing in the places and resources that help professional athletes do their jobs.The stadium also sends a wider message about women’s sports. Female athletes deserve proper facilities, strong support and the chance to play in front of large crowds. Building a venue around a women’s team makes that commitment visible, rather than leaving it as something owners simply promise.How is Brittany Mahomes creating her own identity beyond Patrick Mahomes?Being married to one of the NFL’s biggest stars naturally brings public attention. Patrick’s achievements with the Chiefs have made the Mahomes family familiar to football fans, but Brittany’s work with the Current gives her a separate role in professional sports.She has a playing background, experience in fitness entrepreneurship and a stake in a growing soccer club. These are parts of her career that exist beyond her relationship with Patrick, even though their public profiles often overlap.Their shared involvement in the Kansas City Current also shows how their interests have moved beyond football. Patrick built his career on the NFL field, while Brittany has helped develop a club in a different sport. Together, they are part of a project that connects professional sports, business and the Kansas City community.Brittany’s work does not mean she is responsible for every success the Current achieves, nor does her ownership alone solve the challenges facing women’s soccer. But her involvement gives her a direct role in a club that has invested in its players and facilities and has already enjoyed success in the NWSL.Patrick Mahomes will remain known for what he achieves with the Chiefs.
